verified: edh-c-46 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 17,320), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (fetched 2026-10-31) and the CR (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25): 'attacking player' is the active player, the player whose creature dealt the combat damage (CR 506.2); the controller gains that much and that player loses that much (CR 119.3, eventAmount); played in cloud/edh-c-46 (holes/player.ts word, no new template).

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,173), by hand against the Oracle text, the rulings (illegal target: the spell does not resolve, nothing is drawn or discarded; X in a discarded card is 0) and the CR: the any-target is announced on cast (CR 115.1, 601.2c) by eff.edhv46.choose.anyTarget, then draw three, discard one of your choice, damage equal to the discarded card's mana value to that permanent or player (CR 608.2c, 202.3); played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,157), by hand against the Oracle text, the rulings (a copy of a spell returned to hand ceases to exist; learn is optional) and the CR: one target, a spell on the stack or a permanent, whose mana value is 1 or greater (CR 115.1, 202.3, 608.2b; parser/holes/object.ts), returned to its owner's hand, then learn; played in cloud/edh-c-46 (a mana value 0 permanent is not a legal target).

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,029), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings: counter target spell, exile it instead of the graveyard (rid.countered.exile), the controller of Spelljack may play it without paying its mana cost for as long as it remains exiled (CR 118.9, 611.2a; eff.edhv46.mayPlay.free.dur); only that player, played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,446), by hand against the Oracle text and the CR: rep.edhv46.anyPlayer.draw.skip skips every player's draws (CR 614.10, 121.3) and eff.edhv46.eachPlayer.sacrifice.unless.cost makes each player discard a card or sacrifice a permanent of their choice at each end step (CR 118.12a, 701.21a); played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,421), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings (the greatest number drawn by a single opponent; the total of each opponent's draws this turn, not one instruction): enters with +1/+1 counters equal to the most cards any one opponent drew this turn (happenedCount per player by opponent, CR 121.1, 614.1c, 608.2h; parser/holes/qty.ts), died: draws cards equal to its power; played in cloud/edh-c-46 (a left opponent's draws are not counted: recorded as a known limit).

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,171), by hand against the Oracle text and the CR: eff.edhv46.prevent.byObj.gainLife is a prevention of all the damage the targeted spell would deal this turn with its additional instruction, gain life equal to the damage prevented (CR 615.1a, 615.5, 119.3); the two sentences are joined by parser/lower/ability.ts#joinPreventedThisWay; played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,281), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings (only the creatures attacking or blocking when it resolves; a creature that is untapped at its controller's next untap step is unaffected; the effect follows the creature, not the original controller): tap all blockers, prevent all combat damage this turn, then eff.edhv46.attackingAndBlocking.noUntap locks the attacking and blocking creatures as it resolves (CR 611.2c, 502.3); played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,480), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings (no targets; each opponent discards even if the damage is prevented): eff.edhv46.damageEachOpponent.thoseDiscardRandom, two independent steps over the same group (CR 120.3, 701.9a, 608.2c), the discard random (a player with fewer cards discards all); played in cloud/edh-c-46.

edh-c-46 review (EDHREC rank 17,292), by hand against the Oracle text: at your upkeep the target opponent may exile a card from their graveyard of their choice (eff.edhv46.player.mayExileFromOwnGraveyard, CR 701.13a, 608.2d); if that player doesn't (declines or has no card) you may draw a card (CR 608.2c); played in cloud/edh-c-46 (an instant with the same sentences).
